_note: Each power's voice for its contracts, aligned with NARRATIVE_BIBLE.md and British spelling conventions. Words filled in: {port} destination, {from} issuing harbour, {good}, {qty}, {where}, {site}, {target}, {foe}.

concord.delivery: By authority of the Admiralty at {from}, your vessel is retained to convey {qty} tons of {good} to {port}. Manifests will be presented on arrival and demurrage is not payable.
concord.hunt: By authority of the Gatehold Admiralty, your vessel is retained to interdict and neutralise raider commerce operating {where}. Strict adherence to prize law is expected.
concord.survey: The Hydrographic Office requires an independent inspection of {site}. You will report by wireless and disturb nothing that is not yours to disturb.
concord.escort: A convoy under Concord charter sails for {port}. Your vessel is retained as close escort. Neutral shipping is to be given a wide berth.
concord.smuggle: This office has no knowledge of {qty} tons of {good} bound for {port}, and will have none. Unlawful maritime actors hold that harbour; discretion is expected.
concord.strike: Elements in breach of the Skarn Armistice hold the {target}. You are authorised to reduce its defences. Collateral damage to neutral property will be deducted from your fee.
concord.war: A state of hostilities exists with the {foe}. You are commissioned to take or sink three of their vessels. Prizes are to be condemned in a Concord court.

directorate.delivery: Directive 31-A. {qty} tons of {good} for {port}. Deliver on schedule. Losses will be investigated.
directorate.hunt: Directive 88-B. Enemy raiders violate sovereign Vargan waters {where}. Sink them. Leave no salvage for the oceanic scavengers.
directorate.survey: Directive 52. {site} is to be examined and reported on. What you find belongs to the Directorate.
directorate.escort: Directive 17. A state convoy sails for {port}. You will stay with it. Imperialist corsairs are expected on the route.
directorate.smuggle: Directive unnumbered. {qty} tons of {good} are to reach {port} past the oceanic blockaders. This order does not exist.
directorate.strike: Directive 90. The {target} serves the blockade. Destroy its defences. Do not report partial results.
directorate.war: Directive 101. The {foe} is at war with the people of Varga. Sink three of their ships. Sunk is preferred to taken.

pacific.delivery: The Amakura Maritime Exchange would be obliged if {qty} tons of {good} were to reach {port} in good order. A retainer has been set aside.
pacific.hunt: The Amakura Maritime Exchange notes an unfortunate spike in uninsured piracy {where}. A discreet clearing of the channel would merit a generous retainer.
pacific.survey: A navigational review of {site} is overdue. The Exchange would value an outside opinion, quietly given.
pacific.escort: A Federation convoy for {port} would travel more comfortably in company. The underwriters have approved your name.
pacific.smuggle: Certain goods, {qty} tons of {good}, are awaited at {port} by parties who prefer not to trouble the customs house. The Exchange takes no position.
pacific.strike: The {target} has become an obstacle to navigation. A navigational clearance is requested, with the usual discretion.
pacific.war: Regrettably, relations with the {foe} now require an insurance adjustment: three of their hulls. The Exchange will honour the claim.

combine.delivery: Contract #MC-2210. Transit of {qty} tons of {good} to {port}. Late delivery is a non-performing transit and will be invoiced.
combine.hunt: Contract #MC-3107. Unlicensed operators are degrading freight margins {where}. Liability mitigation is authorised.
combine.survey: Contract #MC-4092. An asset review of {site} is required. Recover data intact. Standard indemnification clauses apply.
combine.escort: Contract #MC-1876. A Combine freight movement to {port} requires third-party risk cover. You are the cover.
combine.smuggle: Contract #MC-0000. Off-ledger placement of {qty} tons of {good} at {port}. The Combine is not a party to this contract.
combine.strike: Contract #MC-5521. The {target} is a non-performing asset held by a hostile counterparty. Write it down.
combine.war: Contract #MC-6004. Market conditions with the {foe} have deteriorated. Remove three units of their tonnage from circulation.

republic.delivery: Tarsa needs {qty} tons of {good} landed at {port}, and needs it now. Every hold that gets through is another day the Republic stays free.
republic.hunt: Raiders are bleeding our coasters {where} while the great powers look the other way. Hunt them down for us, Captain.
republic.survey: Something lies at {site} that the old empires do not want found. Go and look, and bring the truth to Tarsa first.
republic.escort: The Concord thinks it can starve Tarsa into folding. See this convoy through to {port} and prove the Free Republic still has teeth.
republic.smuggle: Our friends in {port} are waiting on {qty} tons of {good}. The customs launches there answer to our enemies. Run it in.
republic.strike: The guns of the {target} are pointed at free men. Silence them, and Tarsa will not forget your name.
republic.war: The {foe} has chosen war with the Republic. Take or sink three of their ships and show them what that costs.

freeport.delivery: {qty} tons of {good} for {port}. No paperwork, half up front, half when it lands. Do not open the crates.
freeport.hunt: Somebody has been working our lanes {where} without paying the Table its share. Keep your guns hot and settle the account.
freeport.survey: A buyer in Port Saffron wants to know what is really at {site}. Go and look, and bring the story back before anyone else hears it.
freeport.escort: Fat convoy bound for {port}, and every wolf between here and there knows it. Ride along and earn your half.
freeport.smuggle: Keep your lights dark. {qty} tons of {good} go into {port} tonight, and the customs men there are not on our payroll.
freeport.strike: The {target} is bad for business. Knock it flat and nobody at the Brokers' Table will ask how.
freeport.war: The {foe} forgot who holds their markers. Three of their ships, sunk or sold, and the debt is settled.

enclave.delivery: {port} is short of {good}. {qty} tons. The ice does not wait, and neither will we.
enclave.hunt: Raiders work the lanes {where}. They take from men who have little. Stop them. We pay in coin and clean charts.
enclave.survey: {site} has not been sounded since the war. Go carefully, and tell us what the cold has kept.
enclave.escort: A convoy for {port}. The pack is moving. Keep them together and bring them all in.
enclave.smuggle: {qty} tons of {good} for {port}. The men who hold that harbour would let it rot on the quay. We owe a debt there.
enclave.strike: The {target} fires on ships that have done it no harm. End that. We respect work done properly.
enclave.war: The {foe} broke its word to us. Three of their ships. Then the account is closed.

ombria.delivery: Official notice: {qty} tons of {good} for the stores at {port}, per the harbour schedule. [In pencil: not all of it need be counted on arrival.]
ombria.hunt: Official notice: unlicensed craft reported {where}; patrol requested. [Tucked inside: they are raiders, and Strelsk will not spare us a hull. Sink them.]
ombria.survey: Official notice: a routine inspection is required at {site}. [In the margin: bring what you find to Sefira before the advisers hear of it.]
ombria.escort: Official notice: a coastal convoy for {port} requests an escort. [Handwritten: it carries more than the manifest says. Lose none of it.]
ombria.smuggle: Official notice: nothing is scheduled for {port}. [Handwritten note tucked inside: {qty} tons of {good}, at night, out of Strelsk's sight.]
ombria.strike: Official notice: gunnery exercises are authorised near the {target}. [In the margin: make sure nothing there still works when you leave.]
ombria.war: Official notice: the Protectorate regrets hostilities with the {foe}. [Handwritten: three of their ships. The junta must be seen to fight.]

isles.delivery: We are out of {good} at {port}, and nobody else is coming. {qty} tons. We will pay what we have.
isles.hunt: Raiders have the lanes {where} pinned down, and Amakura stopped answering our calls months ago. Break them and we will empty the island treasury to pay you.
isles.survey: Our fishermen will not go near {site} any more. Find out why. We cannot spare a boat of our own.
isles.escort: A convoy for {port}: trawlers and one tired destroyer. Without you, half of it will not arrive.
isles.smuggle: {qty} tons of {good} for our people in {port}. The flag over that harbour would seize it. Get it in to them.
isles.strike: The {target} has shelled our boats one time too many. Put it out of action. We were left out of the armistice; we remember who helps.
isles.war: The {foe} thinks the outer islands do not count. Sink three of their ships and they will learn to count.
